description: Whether the instructor signing an endorsement is a flight instructor the FAA's releasable airmen file bears out, by name (the file has no certificate numbers), not the student themselves and not a record another account signs as (14 CFR 61.1, 61.189(a); AC 61-65K).

instructor_name.description: The instructor's name as on their certificate.

student_name.description: The student's name as on their certificate.

registry.description: The releasable file's active flight instructor (type F) records of the instructor's last name; null where the file is not loaded.

id.description: The FAA's unique id, A or C and seven digits.

expires.description: YYYY-MM-DD, only for a certificate issued before 1 Dec 2024 (14 CFR 61.19(d)).

bound_elsewhere.description: Registry ids another Wingtip account already signs as.

reason.description: verified, same_person, registry_unavailable, no_match, ambiguous, claimed or expired.
